name: Emrakul
aliases: the beast that lives within the moon
description: Emrakul is the third of the Eldrazi titans, an enormous eldritch creature that was bound in the moon of Innistrad.

description_citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

summary.text: Emrakul is the third of the Eldrazi titans, an enormous eldritch creature that was bound in the moon of Innistrad.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: Emrakul arrived on Zendikar with Ulamog and Kozilek and was petrified with them over Akoum, but she later left Zendikar and Jace feared she was drifting through the Blind Eternities.

citations.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

bio.text: The Gatewatch aimed to destroy her, and Liliana fought her until she was nearly killed, while Emrakul unfolded above Thraben.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: A silver beam from the moon stretched her until she snapped and collapsed, bound in the moon, after she had taken over Tamiyo's body to read the second scroll.

citations.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.
"The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

bio.text: She also took over Nissa's body on Innistrad.
Years later Tam called on her to feast on the false Multiverse, and Emrakul agreed, engulfed the sky over Hexhaven and began devouring the Echoverse.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi are lured to Zendikar and lulled into torpor by the hedron prison; centuries later they rise again and obliterate the land and the living.
timeline.quote: But when the abominations rose again several centuries later, Zendikar was unprepared for their assault

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Zendikar's people mistake the halos for impartiality, and the angelic Emeria is conceptualized from the silhouette of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: And the terrible silhouette of Emrakul against the sky became Emeria, a vision of salvation on white-feathered wings.

citation.text: "The Defiance of Angels". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2010. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Eldrazi manifest on Zendikar, are confined and sink into dormancy; the planeswalkers disband, Nahiri staying to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The meeting of Sarkhan, Chandra and Jace in the Eye of Ugin loosens the Eldrazi's bonds and they rise to feed again.
timeline.quote: they rose to feed on the life of Zendikar again.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Release of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Titans arrive at Zendikar in -1400 AR and the three planeswalkers fight them.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek , and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers combine their magic at the Eye of Ugin to activate the hedron network, sealing the Titans in stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri warns Zendikar's inhabitants as the Eldrazi approach in -1400 AR, and the three titans descend upon Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Ulamog , Kozilek, and the towering Emrakul descended upon Zendikar

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three planeswalkers fight, converge at the Eye of Ugin and activate the hedron network, sealing the titans in a prison of mana and stone.
timeline.quote: Every hedron on Zendikar shifted into place, sealing the Titans in a prison of mana and stone.

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa Revane releases the titans, and Kozilek's brood is said to retreat to remote corners of the world.
timeline.quote: After the release of the titans Emrakul , Ulamog , and Kozilek by Nissa Revane

citation.text: "Kozilek", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The imprisonment succeeds, The Three disband, and Sorin and Ugin leave, promising to come if Nahiri signals.
timeline.quote: With the Imprisonment of the Eldrazi , the planeswalkers' mission was complete, and The Three disbanded.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "The Three against the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi titans arrive on Zendikar.
timeline.quote: descended upon Zendikar, their monstrous forms dwarfing everything in their path.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Imprisonment of the Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul, Ulamog and Kozilek manifest, are confined by the hedrons and sink into dormancy; Sorin and Ugin leave while Nahiri stays to guard the prison.
timeline.quote: Sorin and Ugin left the plane, while Nahiri remained to watch over Zendikar and protect the Eldrazi's prison.

citation.text: "Zendikar (plane)", section "The Eldrazi". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Eye of Ugin, Nissa shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment, releasing the Eldrazi titans.
timeline.quote: Nissa, believing the titans should be freed to return to the stars, shatters the central hedron and dissolves the binding enchantment.

citation.work: Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum
citation.text: "Zendikar: In the Teeth of Akoum", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's corruption creates horrors in other colors of mana on Innistrad.
timeline.quote: In The Travails , as a consequence of Emrakul 's corruption, a variety of horrors have appeared in other colors of mana

citation.text: "Horror", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Emrakul's arrival the grotto hosts a many-headed horror that devours those who enter.
timeline.quote: With the arrival of Emrakul , the grotto became host to a horror that devoured anyone who dared enter.

citation.text: "Kessig", section "Locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Emrakul is summoned, benevolent geists bond with cathars, forming the Order of Saint Traft.
timeline.quote: the Order of Saint Traft was formed from this union.

citation.text: "Spirit", section "Varieties and factions". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Corrupted by Emrakul, Avacyn goes mad and the new Flight of Moonsilver aids her genocidal rampage against humanity.
timeline.quote: aiding her in her genocidal rampage against humanity

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Moonsilver". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn's madness is revealed to be caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Avacyn's madness was caused by Nahiri's cryptoliths summoning Emrakul to the plane

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Corruption and death". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad Liliana fails to exorcise the Veil's spirits, but harms Emrakul with the Veil's power.
timeline.quote: She failed.

citation.text: "Chain Veil", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri's cryptoliths, powered by Innistrad's leylines, summon Emrakul and drive many angels, including Avacyn, mad.
timeline.quote: These cryptholiths also caused multiple angels

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "The Travails". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri destroys Markov Manor, builds cryptoliths and the Drownyard Temple, and summons Emrakul to Innistrad.
timeline.quote: She attacked Markov Manor , destroying it with lithomancy

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The three titans Ulamog, Kozilek, and Emrakul arrive on Zendikar, and Ugin and Sorin fight their brood as the titans march toward the hedron nexus.
timeline.quote: Ugin breathed his ghostfire, searing the Eldrazi brood with invisible flame.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: The three Eldrazi stand petrified over Akoum and the chamber is sealed with a lock that requires three Planeswalkers to open.
timeline.quote: Looming above the highlands of Akoum, the three Eldrazi stood petrified, surrounded by a web of floating hedrons.

citation.text: "The Lithomancer" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Oct 2014.

timeline.summary: Gideon turns the tide against the brood at Fort Keff until Emrakul darkens the skies; he orders everyone to flee.
timeline.quote: Gideon told all the beings of the fort to flee

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "The Battle of Fort Keff". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nissa releases the Titans, Emrakul vanishes and is drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, who wants revenge on Sorin.
timeline.quote: She was drawn through the Blind Eternities to the plane of Innistrad by the planeswalker Nahiri

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn holds Emrakul at bay until Sorin unmakes her, and then Emrakul enters Innistrad physically.
timeline.quote: once she was unmade by Sorin, the titan physically entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gatewatch and Liliana confront Emrakul at Thraben; Jace speaks with her figment Emeria.
timeline.quote: Emrakul was confronted by the Gatewatch and Liliana Vess

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul possesses Tamiyo and forces her to read a scroll, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: She possessed Tamiyo and forced her to read a scroll she had vowed to never read, voluntarily trapping herself in Innistrad's moon .

citation.text: "Emrakul", section "The Eldrazi released". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul and Kozilek vanish six months after release, leaving Ulamog to ravage Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Six months after they had been released, both Emrakul and Kozilek vanished, only leaving a few spawn behind.

citation.text: "Ulamog", section "The Battle for Zendikar". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin unmakes Avacyn after Emrakul's corruption.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's corruption forces Sorin to unmake Avacyn.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana formally joins the Gatewatch.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "Gatewatch Period". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace swears the oath, warning that Emrakul could be drifting through the Blind Eternities.
timeline.quote: Never again. For the sake of the Multiverse, I will keep watch.

citation.text: "Oath of the Gatewatch" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace explains the plan and Ugin reveals that Emrakul is gone from Zendikar and that he knew the titans could be killed.
timeline.quote: Emrakul is gone, and has been for some time.

citation.text: "Zendikar Resurgent". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 24 Feb 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin; Avacyn and the angels go mad, and Emrakul corrupts inhabitants.
timeline.quote: She was summoned to Innistrad by Nahiri to take revenge on Sorin, and her presence drove Avacyn and the angels to madness.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul allows herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: Emrakul allowed herself to be imprisoned in Innistrad's moon for an unknown purpose.

citation.text: "Eldrazi", section "Shadows over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: On Innistrad, Emrakul's influence causes madness; Jace brings the Gatewatch back, Liliana arrives with a zombie army, and Nissa is nearly killed by the Chain Veil's power.
timeline.quote: On Innistrad, Jace found only madness that affected the entire plane

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul is sealed in Innistrad's moon, and Liliana decides to join the Gatewatch to direct it.
timeline.quote: Emrakul had been sealed in Innistrad's moon by the Gatewatch and Tamiyo

citation.text: "Gatewatch", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises a zombie army against the Eldrazi Horrors.
timeline.quote: she began to raise a zombie army to fight the Eldrazi Horrors overrunning the plane

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Shadows Over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana joins the Gatewatch after the Battle of Thraben.
timeline.quote: she decided to join the Gatewatch , albeit to direct them for her plans

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Shadows Over Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's presence forces Saint Traft out of Thalia, nearly driving her mad.
timeline.quote: forced Saint Traft to leave Thalia's body

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Order of Saint Traft". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri calls to the sky for Emrakul to come to Innistrad as the plane trembles.
timeline.quote: Come to me. Come to Innistrad!

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri sees the temple she constructed for the god no longer empty.
timeline.quote: To the temple she had constructed for the god. It was no longer empty.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: A mad angel announces that Emrakul is rising and dives at Maeli.
timeline.quote: She dove down, her blade slicing through the air ahead of her.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Edith, in a crowd of cultists, begs to be chosen as Emrakul rises.
timeline.quote: Choose me! Me! Me'mrakul.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul rises from the sea at the Drownyard.
timeline.quote: And then Emrakul rose.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul looks upon Edith, who feels chosen.
timeline.quote: She looked down at Edith with one enormous, glowing magenta eye.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Bruna and Gisela are gone, becoming one fused angel that proclaims Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel parted four wings, reached out with two arms, and cried with a single voice that sprang from two mouths

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's angel leads the faithful below in a chorus of We are Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Emrakul's angel led all below in following Her radiant form.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace sees Emrakul for the first time, bigger than the others, with all of Innistrad following her.
timeline.quote: It was the first time he had actually seen Her: the titan, Emrakul.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace asks Emrakul her name and is flooded with words of conquest.
timeline.quote: The beginning—I shall be all.

citation.text: "Emrakul Rises" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri tells Sorin she brought Emrakul to his doorstep.
timeline.quote: I brought Emrakul to your doorstep, and you still think I'm a child.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri declares she is done being a warden and that Zendikar will never again be a prison, so Emrakul had to go somewhere.
timeline.quote: I'm done being a warden, and Zendikar will never again be a prison.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin, trapped, watches Emrakul drift across Gavony toward Thraben.
timeline.quote: The horizon was Emrakul.

citation.text: "Campaign of Vengeance" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 6 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin kills Avacyn and Emrakul enters Innistrad, corrupting the remaining angels into the Flight of Nightmares led by Brisela.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn's death at the hands of her creator Sorin , Emrakul successfully entered Innistrad

citation.text: "Angel", section "The Flight of Nightmares". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben the Gatewatch is saved by Liliana; Chandra then defends the others during the sealing of Emrakul.
timeline.quote: When it became clear that they could not destroy Emrakul, Chandra joined Gideon in defending the other members of the Gatewatch while they conducted the sealing ritual.

citation.text: "Chandra Nalaar", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sigarda resists Emrakul's influence and defends humanity, giving rise to the Sigardian Sect.
timeline.quote: Sigarda and the remnants of her Flight were of the few angels who never succumbed to Emrakul's influence

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "The Sigardian Sect". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival transforms the Ashmouth, spawning warped Ashspawn demons.
timeline.quote: Warped and twisted demons emerged from the chasm.

citation.text: "Demon", section "The Ashspawn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival makes Innistrad's dryads more aggressive.
timeline.quote: With the arrival of Emrakul , many dryads became more aggressive

citation.text: "Dryad", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: When Nahiri draws Emrakul to Innistrad, most of her spawn stay on Zendikar and Emrakul corrupts native Innistrad creatures into mutated spawn.
timeline.quote: When Emrakul was drawn to Innistrad by Nahiri, most of her spawns were left on Zendikar.

citation.text: "Eldrazi/Lineages", section "Emrakul's Lineage". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri summons Emrakul to Innistrad to take revenge on Sorin Markov.
timeline.quote: Nahiri has summoned Emrakul to the plane, to take revenge on Sorin Markov .

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul twists plants, animals and sentient beings into Eldrazi Horrors.
timeline.quote: twists all things living, be it plants, animals, or sentient beings, into Eldrazi Horrors

citation.text: "Eldritch Moon", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival makes Innistrad's elementals more aggressive.
timeline.quote: In the wake of Emrakul 's arrival, the elementals, like the Gnarlwood Dryad , became more aggressive.

citation.text: "Elemental", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival on Innistrad fuses fishermen to their prey.
timeline.quote: several fishermen found themselves fused to their prey

citation.text: "Fish", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul's arrival on Innistrad turns local fungi into threats such as the Moldgraf Scavenger.
timeline.quote: entities like the Moldgraf Scavenger formed from the local fungi, threatening humans

citation.text: "Fungus", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At the Battle of Thraben, Liliana helps the Gatewatch; Gideon is trapped in an illusion with Erebos, freed by Jace, while Emrakul is sealed in the moon.
timeline.quote: Gideon was trapped in a scene where he was confronted again by Erebos

citation.text: "Gideon Jura", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad; Sorin is beaten and encased in stone by Nahiri, then abandoned by Olivia, who takes his sword.
timeline.quote: where he was bested by the Lithomancer and encased in stone

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: At Thraben Sigarda slays Brisela, and Jace and Tamiyo imprison Emrakul in the Moon of Innistrad.
timeline.quote: Jace Beleren and Tamiyo imprisoned Emrakul within the Moon of Innistrad

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin destroys Avacyn and Emrakul arrives.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov showed up and destroyed his creation.

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jace, Nissa and Tamiyo trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: Jace combined forces with Nissa and Tamiyo to trap Emrakul in Innistrad's moon

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo reveals that Emrakul overtook her and wanted to be sealed.
timeline.quote: Tamiyo revealed that she had been overtaken by Emrakul when she had cast the second spell

citation.text: "Jace Beleren", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul willingly lets herself be sealed in Innistrad's moon.
timeline.quote: The Eldrazi titan Emrakul willingly let herself be sealed in Innistrad's moon

citation.text: "Moon of Innistrad", section "Emrakul in the Moon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Hanweir declares independence during the Travails and is transformed into an Eldrazi ooze by Emrakul.
timeline.quote: Hanweir was transformed into an Eldrazi Ooze after contact with Emrakul

citation.text: "Nearheath", section "The Hanweir Secession". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nissa's sigil is branded on Innistrad's moon, trapping Emrakul inside.
timeline.quote: Nissa's sigil was branded on the moon, trapping Emrakul inside.

citation.text: "Nissa Revane", section "Battle of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Emrakul arrives on Innistrad as Sorin realizes he played into Nahiri's plan.
timeline.quote: Promptly, Emrakul arrived on Innistrad.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Unmaking of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, corrupted by Emrakul's presence, attacks humanity and is destroyed by her creator Sorin Markov in the Cathedral of Thraben.
timeline.quote: a final confrontation in the Cathedral of Thraben with her creator, Sorin Markov , who ultimately destroyed her

timeline.summary: Emrakul's corruption devastates the Falkenrath and Stromkirk bloodlines.

timeline.summary: Emrakul unfolds, growing countless tendrils and releasing a wave of power that hits every planeswalker.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana blasts Emrakul back with necromantic energy, believing she is winning.
timeline.quote: For the first time since blossoming, Emrakul was shrinking

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's body begins to fail and Emrakul regrows faster than she can blast it, forcing her onto the defensive.
timeline.quote: now it was all she could do to stand her ground

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana's zombies are destroyed by the hundreds as she fights only to survive another moment.
timeline.quote: Zombies were destroyed by the hundreds under Emrakul's assault

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace returns to find Liliana unconscious and bleeding, and Emrakul fully unfolded above Thraben.
timeline.quote: Liliana was on the ground in front of him, unconscious, bleeding profusely from multiple wounds.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.quote: Emrakul was gone. They had won.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana, having survived, stares at the moon and curses Emrakul to rot there forever.
timeline.quote: May you rot there forever.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Tamiyo tearfully tells Jace that Emrakul took over her body to read the second scroll.
timeline.quote: It...she...took me over.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.quote: instead it fueled a spell that trapped herself here

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: Jace, alone, recalls the angel's words that it is not her time yet and goes to find a bed.
timeline.quote: It is not my time. Not yet.

citation.text: "The Promised End" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 27 Jul 2016.

timeline.summary: In the trial Nissa suffers a nightmare of an angel who says she can do anything, a voice she realizes was both Emrakul's and her own.
timeline.quote: The monster had taken over her body back on Innistrad.

citation.text: "The Hand That Moves" by Ken Troop. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Apr 2017.

timeline.summary: The woman in violet gives a cold answer, then pours drinks and toasts to new good old days to keep Jace there.

citation.text: "The Flood" by Alison Lührs. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 10 Jan 2018.

citation.text: "Adeline", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
